Smith takes a good low catch to his right at slip and Bangladesh are nine down. Taskin Ahmed c Steven Smith b Lyon 8(11) [6s-1]

Lyon to Shoriful Islam, out Caught by Mitchell Starc!! Has taken Australia just three balls after tea to wrap it all up! After the shock defeat in Darwin, they've bounced back in style, beating Bangladesh inside two days in Mackay. Series finishes 1-1 and fittingly it's Mitchell Starc who takes the catch to seal the deal. Tossed up outside off, Shoriful Islam gives the charge, goes for a big slog but isn't to the pitch of it as the ball dips and turns. It takes a thick edge and balloons towards backward point where Starc jumps for an overhead grab. Shoriful Islam c Mitchell Starc b Lyon 0(2)
